reasoning: On the season so far the Pistons are the stronger team; with home court the Pistons start about 11 points better, in a game of about 235 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 3 points towards the Pelicans.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Pistons win 74 times in 100, by about 8; most games like this end between 209 and 257 total points.
